newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway C. Bank sets second fixed-term deposit rate.
newsitem.headline: Norway C. Bank sets second fixed-term deposit rate.

text.p: Norway's central bank, Norges Bank, said on Tuesday it had set an interest rate of 3.6 percent for its fixed-term deposit rate running for the period July 1 to July 3.
It is the second time within a week that the bank has announced a fixed interest rate.
Norges Bank regularly announces fixed-term deposits or fixed-term loans, which usually are carried out through ordinary auction, in order to control money market liquidity.

On Thursday the bank set an interest rate of 3.6 percent for its fixed-term deposit rate for the period July 1 to July 14. That time analysts said the bank appeared to be testing the market's reaction to higher money market rates to see if it was enough to stabilise the crown.
The bank has previously announced fixed interest rates at times of instability in the money market or if the fixed term collided with a repo arrangement.
